owner: src/Baxy.Providers.Windows/External/SpotifyDesktopAutomation.ps1 (console output encoding UTF-8 before emitting the JSON), src/Baxy.Providers.Windows/External/WindowsVisibleOcrLocator.cs (the smaller print wins among duplicate labels with a 5 % margin) and src/Baxy.Providers.Windows/Applications/WindowsInstalledApplicationOpenProvider.cs (app.open waits up to 30 s for the launched window), on top of the MUSIC1773 build.
